user.title: Create your household
user.description: Set up a household to track its spending.

abort.already_configured: A household with this name already exists.

add_expense.name: Add expense
add_expense.description: Records an expense in a bucket. A negative amount records a refund.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much was spent. Use a negative amount for a refund.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day the expense happened. Defaults to today, and may be backdated.

edit_expense.name: Edit expense
edit_expense.description: Changes an existing expense. Targeting a bucket moves the expense to it.

expense_id.name: Expense ID
expense_id.description: The ID returned when the expense was added.

delete_expense.name: Delete expense
delete_expense.description: Deletes an expense. The bucket's figures correct themselves immediately.

expense_id.name: Expense ID
expense_id.description: The ID of the expense to delete.

list_expenses.name: List expenses
list_expenses.description: Returns expenses without changing anything. Covers every bucket when no target is given.

date_from.name: From date
date_from.description: Only expenses on or after this day.

date_to.name: To date
date_to.description: Only expenses on or before this day.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of expenses to return, newest first.

no_bucket_target.message: No bucket was targeted. Pick a bucket's device or one of its entities.

multiple_bucket_targets.message: This action works on one bucket at a time, but {buckets} were targeted.
